见两人眼中的杀气稍微散去几分，李汪大着胆子往前蹭了半步，满脸希冀。

“哥，姐，你们是两口子吧？”

“大佬！亲哥亲姐！我能加入你们吗！我有天赋【犬类亲和】，黄黄的鼻子特别灵，不仅能找物资，还能帮咱们放哨侦查！绝对不吃白饭！”

小孩子年纪不大，乱点鸳鸯谱？

许默眼底刚刚浮现的缓和瞬间消失，毫不犹豫地泼下一盆冰水。

“没门。”

“我们现在也是泥菩萨过河自身难保，庇护所刚刚起步，连自己明天还能不能喘气都不知道，根本没那个物资和精力去接纳其他人。”

女孩眼里的光瞬间熄灭了，连带着一旁的黄黄也垂下了尾巴，喉咙里发出可怜巴巴的呜咽声。

看着这对难兄难弟的惨状，许默话锋极其突兀地一转。

“不过，倒是可以加个好友。以后遇上要命的紧急情况，或者手里有富余的物资想换点什么，可以通过系统面板联系。”

李汪疯狂点头，手忙脚乱地唤出系统面板操作起来。

伴随着微弱的白光，一条好友申请弹了出来。

许默指尖轻点确认，目光不动声色地扫过对方的资料界面，心头微动。

面板上，代表交易图标是灰色的。

穷得连十个基础生存点都掏不出来，或者连交易功能都没资格解锁，这家伙能带着一条狗活到现在，简直是奇迹。

加上了好友，李汪也深知好歹，没敢继续死皮赖脸地缠着。

她恋恋不舍地牵着黄黄，一步三回头。

许默突然厉声断喝。

“站住。”

李汪浑身一激灵，僵硬地转过身。

许默上前一步，语气严肃。

“在这个鬼地方，把你那套天真的学生做派彻底收起来。别轻易交底，别轻易相信任何人。记住，有时候长着两只脚的同类，比黑暗里长着獠牙的野兽更危险。管严你的嘴！”

李汪红着眼狠狠点头，随后牵着黄黄，逃也似的钻进了灌木丛中。

方芸这才彻底卸下弓弦询问。

“你觉得她刚才说的那些话，有几分真？”

许默抬起袖口，抹去额头因高度戒备渗出的汗。

“演不出这么天真，估计在蓝星就是个涉世未深、被保护得极好的学生。但这种毫无防备的蠢材，在这个吃人的世界往往死得最快，甚至会把危险引给身边的人。”

“防人之心不可无。那个半塌地洞离咱们才两公里，等于在家门口埋了个定时炸弹。明天我会给蚁后下达指令，让蚁群扩大巡逻圈，死死盯住这个方向的所有风吹草动。”

方芸深以为然地点头，将锋利的箭重新塞回腰间。

小插曲过后，生存的重压再次袭来。

Seeing that the murderous look in their eyes had dissipated a little, Li Wang boldly took half a step forward, his face full of hope.

"Brother, sister, are you a couple?"

"Boss! My dear brother and dear sister! Can I join you! I have the talent [Canine Affinity], and my yellow nose is particularly good. Not only can I find supplies, but I can also help us with sentry investigation! I will definitely not eat for nothing!"

The child is not old enough to mess with the rules?

The relief that just appeared in Xu Mo's eyes disappeared instantly, and he poured a basin of ice water without hesitation.

"No way."

"Now we are like the Clay Buddha crossing the river and cannot protect ourselves. The shelter has just started. We don't even know if we can breathe tomorrow. We simply don't have the resources or energy to accept other people."

The light in the girl's eyes went out instantly, and Huang Huang also lowered his tail, a pitiful whimpering sound coming from his throat.

Seeing the miserable situation of the two brothers in distress, Xu Mo changed the subject very suddenly.

"However, you can add a friend. If you encounter a fatal emergency in the future, or if you have extra supplies and want to exchange for something, you can contact him through the system panel."

Li Wang nodded frantically and hurriedly called out the system panel to operate it.

Along with the faint white light, a friend request popped up.

Xu Mo tapped his fingertips to confirm, his eyes swept over the other party's information interface calmly, his heart moved slightly.

On the panel, the icon representing the transaction is gray.

He is so poor that he cannot even afford ten basic survival points, or he is not even qualified to unlock the trading function. It is simply a miracle that this guy can survive with a dog until now.

With the addition of friends, Li Wang also knew what was good and didn't dare to continue to pester him shamelessly.

She reluctantly held Huang Huang's hand, looking back three times every step of the way.

Xu Mo suddenly shouted loudly.

"Stop."

Li Wang was shocked and turned around stiffly.

Xu Mo took a step forward with a serious tone.

"In this hellish place, put away your innocent student behavior completely. Don't confess easily, and don't trust anyone easily. Remember, sometimes the same kind with two legs is more dangerous than the beast with fangs in the dark. Watch your mouth!"

Li Wang nodded fiercely with red eyes, and then led Huang Huang into the bushes as if he was running away.

Fang Yun then completely removed the bowstring and asked.

"How true do you think what she just said is true?"

Xu Mo raised his cuffs and wiped away the sweat on his forehead due to the high level of alertness.

"If he can't act so innocent, he's probably just an inexperienced and well-protected student in Blue Star. But such an unsuspecting idiot often dies the quickest in this cannibalistic world, and may even introduce danger to those around him."

"It is essential to be on guard against others. That half-collapsed hole is only two kilometers away from us. It is like planting a time bomb at the door of our house. Tomorrow I will give an order to the Queen Ant and ask the ant colony to expand the patrol circle and keep an eye on all disturbances in this direction."

Fang Yun nodded in agreement and stuffed the sharp arrow back into her waist.

After the small episode, the pressure of survival struck again.
